items.title: Fibers and injectivity of the degree-four cyclic Prym map on the hyperelliptic-intermediate component
items.author: Anatoli Shatsila
items.difficulty_reason: One Prym-map fiber theorem requires explicit cyclic-cover quotient curves and Weierstrass moduli, intrinsic polarized Prym decomposition/kernel recovery, genus2 fibers described through a smooth intersection of quadrics and its involution, and higher-genus Jacobian/Torelli reconstruction. All two exceptional genus2 fibers, cross-ratio exclusions and restriction to the hyperelliptic-intermediate component retained. Old184057 only counts geomprym355–386, the addition-kernel and polarized-quotient support; the complete moduli/fiber and reconstruction arguments are additional content. Genus cases count together, no supporting lemma or exceptional case split. No author mathematics reviewed or corrected.

primary.label: Complete original main theorem, g>=3 injectivity and genus2 fibers with two exceptions as one Prym-map object

proof_spans.label: Complete cover/quotient equations, moduli parameterization, Prym kernel geometry, genus2 quadric-fiber quotient proof and higher-genus reconstruction proof

contexts.label: Original degree4 etale cyclic-cover moduli, polarization and hyperelliptic-intermediate component scope
